## Geometric Datasets

[WordNet](https://wordnet.princeton.edu/) (semantic category),
[ImageNet](https://www.image-net.org/) (semantic category images),
[ShapeNet](https://huggingface.co/ShapeNet) (rich in attributes).

**Other 3D Object and Scene Datasets:**

- [A Large Dataset of Object Scans](http://redwood-data.org/3dscan/) ([paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/1602.02481))
- [Thingi10K: A Dataset of 10,000 3D-Printing Models](https://ten-thousand-models.appspot.com/)
- [ABC: A Big CAD Model Dataset for Geometric Deep Learning](https://deep-geometry.github.io/abc-dataset/)
- [Objaverse-XL](https://objaverse.allenai.org/)
- [ScanNet](https://www.scan-net.org/ScanNet/)
- [ScanNet++](https://scannetpp.mlsg.cit.tum.de/scannetpp/)
- [SceneNet](https://github.com/ankurhanda/SceneNetv1.0)

**Driving Datasets:**

- [Waymo Open Dataset](https://waymo.com/open/)
- [SemanticKITTI](https://www.semantic-kitti.org/)

**4D Datasets:**

- [HOI4D: A 4D Egocentric Dataset for Category-Level Human-Object Interaction](https://hoi4d.github.io/)
- [BEHAVE: Dataset and Method for Tracking Human Object Interactions](https://virtualhumans.mpi-inf.mpg.de/behave/)
- [EgoBody: Human Body Shape and Motion of Interacting People from Head-Mounted Devices](https://sanweiliti.github.io/egobody/egobody.html)
- [ARCTIC: A Dataset for Dexterous Bimanual Hand-Object Manipulation](https://arctic.is.tue.mpg.de/)

**Virtual Environments:**

- [ThreeDWorld (TDW)](https://github.com/threedworld-mit/tdw)
- [AI2-THOR](https://ai2thor.allenai.org/)
- [DeepMind Lab](https://github.com/google-deepmind/lab)
- [Gibson](https://gibsonenv.github.io/)
- [Habitat](https://aihabitat.org/)
- [HoME](https://arxiv.org/abs/1711.11017)
- [MuJoCo](https://mujoco.org/)
- [PyBullet](https://pybullet.org/)
- [VirtualHome](https://github.com/xavierpuigf/virtualhome)
- [iGibson](https://svl.stanford.edu/igibson/)
- [SAPIEN: A SimulAted Part-Based Interactive ENvironment](https://sapien.ucsd.edu/)

**AI+Geometry:**

- $S$ — Shape, $c$ — label or condition

- $P(c \mid S)$ — Shape analysis
  - Learning shape descriptors
  - Shape classification, segmentation, view estimation, etc.

- $P(S)$ or $P(S \mid c)$ — Shape synthesis
  - Learning (conditional) shape priors
  - Shape generation, completion, & reconstruction

## Data-Driven Shape Analysis

**Multi-View Representations:** 

- $\mathrm{CNN}_1$: a ConvNet extracting image features
- $\mathrm{CNN}_2$: a second ConvNet producing shape descriptors
